story.heading: Overview
story.body:
HandyNaija is a UX/UI case study focused on designing a trusted, seamless home services marketplace for urban users.

This project explores how thoughtful user research, clear problem definition, and scalable design systems can simplify service discovery, booking, and payments in a two-sided platform. From personas and empathy mapping to high-fidelity screens and prototyping, HandyNaija demonstrates a research-driven approach to creating reliable, human-centered mobile experiences.
